data.message: Five hundred kilometers of silence, and you open with stillness. Interesting choice. Let's see how you argue under thrust.
A single torpedo — cautious. I prefer commitments in pairs. Watch the spacing.
Two inbound, eleven seconds. I've already done the arithmetic on this line — have you?
Three seconds. Yours finds two meters of nose — already budgeted. Mine travel together, as promised. Check your spacing.
